title: Informa TechTarget Relaunches its Flagship Editorial Brand ‘TechTarget’ As an Indispensable Daily Intelligence Source for Enterprise Technology Decision Makers
summary: TechTarget builds on its heritage as a trusted authority on enterprise technology with an expanded depth of tech industry coverage, a redesigned website with AI search, and five connected communities. The relaunch unifies a network
body_markdown:
- TechTarget builds on its heritage as a trusted authority on enterprise technology with an expanded depth of tech industry coverage, a redesigned website with AI search, and five connected communities.
- The relaunch unifies a network of specialized sites into one comprehensive editorial destination to drive more meaningful engagement with professionals working across five core enterprise IT communities: AI, Cybersecurity, Data, Infrastructure, and CIO strategy.
- The refreshed editorial approach supports how enterprise technology decisions are made within organizations today—with both specialized and interconnected, cross-disciplinary topical coverage to help business professionals quickly find the information they need to make important decisions.


Informa TechTarget (Nasdaq: TTGT)—an indispensable partner for B2B intelligence, media, and marketing solutions—today announced the relaunch of its flagship IT editorial brand, TechTarget, as a comprehensive news and intelligence destination for enterprise technology leaders and practitioners working across AI, Cybersecurity, Data, Infrastructure, and CIO roles. Building on its heritage of award-winning technical reporting across several specialized areas, the new TechTarget brings this coverage together to deliver a connected, cross-disciplinary view of the leaders, innovations, technical updates, broader trends, and business decisions continually reshaping the field of enterprise technology. With a redesigned web experience and new editorially curated newsletters, TechTarget is poised to deliver even more in-depth journalism to, and drive richer engagement with, its global audience of technology and business decision-makers.


With this newly integrated editorial approach reflecting how enterprise technology decisions are made today, TechTarget is designed to help tech and business leaders connect the dots around AI, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure, cloud architecture, executive strategy and more, to make better-informed decisions. To support this, Informa TechTarget has unified a network of previously separate, highly specialized editorial brands into five connected community channels—TechTarget AI, TechTarget Cybersecurity, TechTarget Data, TechTarget Infrastructure, and TechTarget CIO—each one delivering deep coverage of a multitude of niche topics supporting the larger focus. By concentrating the journalistic expertise of editorial teams from previously separate editorial brands, including AI Business, Data Center Knowledge, and No Jitter, TechTarget is making it easier for audiences to access its extensive breadth of coverage.


“We’ve redesigned TechTarget to be that indispensable daily intelligence platform that enterprise technology leaders and practitioners continuously turn to for guidance,” said Davide Savenije, SVP, Editorial at Informa TechTarget, who recently completed his term as President of the American Society of Business Publication Editors (ASBPE). “We aim to be a trusted authority that reports on the news that matters, contextualizes it with expertise, and helps tech leaders understand what it means for their organizations and their roles.”


TechTarget aims to be an essential part of its audience’s daily workflows through deeper engagement fostered across dedicated topical sections, editorially curated newsletters, webinars and virtual events aligned to five core communities:


- [TechTarget AI](https://www.techtarget.com/topic/ai/) , covering AI and emerging technologies with a focus on actionable insights, trusted reporting and practical guidance for executives and technical leaders.
- [TechTarget CIO](https://www.techtarget.com/topic/cio/) , serving CIOs and senior technology leaders with reporting and analysis that connects technology developments to enterprise decisions.
- [TechTarget Cybersecurity](https://www.techtarget.com/topic/cybersecurity/) , delivering sharp analysis and decision support for CISOs and security leaders navigating a fast-changing threat landscape.
- [TechTarget Data](https://www.techtarget.com/topic/data/) , providing authoritative coverage on data management, protection, analytics, governance and the strategic role of data in the age of AI.
- [TechTarget Infrastructure](https://www.techtarget.com/topic/infrastructure/) , offering technical depth and market perspective for leaders responsible for cloud, data center, networking and IT operations.


“With top-to-bottom coverage across AI, cybersecurity, data, infrastructure and enterprise strategy, TechTarget is poised to be the connective tissue across the enterprise technology landscape,” said Nick Martin, Senior Managing Editor of TechTarget. “Our editorial team is the best in the business, with an unmatched level of technical understanding and specialized journalism experience. We’re excited to help CIOs, CISOs, and all of our readers better understand individual technologies and how they work together to create business value.”


Designed to help readers find relevant reporting and analysis faster, the updated TechTarget site experience features a continually refreshed homepage, streamlined design, intuitive user interface, improved navigation, and an AI-powered cross-site search experience—which spans the entirety of Informa TechTarget’s editorial portfolio, including Channel Dive, Computer Weekly, Dark Reading and Information Week.


“High-quality journalism is the cornerstone of our business. As technology professionals sift through a barrage of content to find the vetted, reliable information they need to make important business decisions, the new TechTarget makes it easier for them to find precisely what they need within the depth and breadth of our editorial coverage,” said Jane Qin Medeiros, GM, Brand and Content at Informa TechTarget. “By delivering this value and deepening our engagement with our audiences, we’ll be in an even better position to advise and support the B2B marketers who seek to understand and engage with these important decision-makers.”


The relaunched TechTarget is now live at[www.techtarget.com](http://www.techtarget.com/) , and audiences can sign up[here](https://www.techtarget.com/signup/) for any of the five new community-specific newsletters launching this week. To learn more about Informa TechTarget’s broader editorial ecosystem, which celebrated[its best journalism awards performance to date](https://www.informatechtarget.com/press-release/informa-techtarget-celebrates-its-best-journalism-awards-performance-to-date-with-57-award-wins-across-three-prestigious-editorial-awards-programs/) earlier this year,[click here](https://www.informatechtarget.com/our-brands/) .


**About Informa TechTarget**


Informa TechTarget is a leading global B2B intelligence, media, and marketing services company, purpose-built to be an indispensable partner to the enterprise tech and vertical industry sectors. Our award-winning industry journalism delivers business audiences the information and insights they need to make important decisions. B2B GTM teams trust Informa TechTarget’s best-in-class market insights, digital media brands, unified brand-and-demand solutions, content strategy and creation, and exclusive buyer intelligence to identify growth opportunities, build brand trust, engage with in-market buyers, and impact revenue. With 58 million+ permissioned members, Informa TechTarget’s robust B2B audience engagement network powers our data-driven, AI-enabled, integrated marketing capabilities, addressing our clients’ needs across the GTM lifecycle.


Informa TechTarget is headquartered in Boston, MA and has offices in 19 global locations. For more information, visit informatechtarget.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
